summary: The race judge's in-memory overrides can now edit a prefab's component by its fileID, and override paths can index List fields.
why: Step-5 vessel tuning searches Time levers that live on prefab components (Scarab ThrottleScalerMultiplier, Sparrow BoostSpeedMultiplier, TrailFollower ride speed). Used locally for the fair before/after behind #2110-#2112 and #2125: an override of Scarab 1.5 moved its Regatta time 62 -> 49.6 s as expected. Judge-only, nothing writes assets.
